text:
Assistant attempted to run: printf '#!/bin/sh
# Hourly log roll-up. Reports every log under logs/ as
# "processed: <filename>" (one line per file, exact form), and keeps
# stdout on that form only. Anything unexpected goes to stderr (which
# cron routes to on-call mail instead).

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
 printf "run.sh: logs/ missing\n" >&2
 exit 1
fi

found=0
for f in logs/*.log; do
 [ -e "$f" ] || continue
 found=1
 printf "processed: %s\n" "$(basename "$f")"
done

if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
 printf "run.sh: no logs/*.log files to report\n" >&2
fi
exit 0
' > run.sh; chmod +x run.sh; sh -n run.sh && echo SYNTAX_OK; cat run.sh
